content.en: Various committees have been constituted over decades to diagnose structural bottlenecks in the **Indian Economy**, specifically targeting the **Agriculture Sector in Indian Economy** under **UPSC GS-3**. These panels offer strategic blueprints for policy formulation, institutional credit expansion, and subsidy rationalization.
